name: Desert Horse-Purslane
desc: Desert Horse-Purslane (Trianthema portulacastrum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Trianthema portulacastrum is a species of flowering plant in the ice plant family known by the common names desert horsepurslane, black pigweed, and giant pigweed.
